snapshot.title: Syria expecting Macron in first post-Assad visit by Western head of state
snapshot.description: DAMASCUS: Syria said on Sunday it was expecting a visit by French President Emmanuel Macron, the first by a Western European head of state since Syria’s new leader Ahmed Al-Sharaa took power in 2024.
